column2: A compensating error — two errors of equal amount on opposite sides leave the totals agreeing. The other three all unbalance the trial balance. F6.1 §6

column1: Outstanding salary at the end of the year is
column2: A liability — an expense incurred but not paid. F6.3 §5

column1: Under the written down value method, depreciation is charged on
column2: On the opening book value of each year, so the charge falls over time — the distinguishing feature against the straight line method. F6.4 §2

column1: Accounting Standard 2 requires inventory to be valued at
column2: The lower of cost and net realisable value. F6.4 §5

column1: A bill of exchange is drawn
column2: By the creditor upon the debtor — the drawer is the creditor. F6.6

column1: The primary object of an audit is to
column2: To express an opinion on a true and fair view. Detection of fraud is incidental, not primary — F6.7 §2, and the item the 2023 paper tested

column1: For a moderately skewed distribution, the empirical relationship between the averages is
column2: Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean. F6.8 §2

column1: Gross National Product exceeds Gross Domestic Product when
column2: GNP = GDP + NFIA, so GNP exceeds GDP when NFIA is positive. For India it is normally negative. F4.1 §1.1

column1: The Reserve Bank's Consumer Price Index inflation target is
column2: 4% with a band of ±2, so 2% to 6%. F4.2 §2.2

column1: The fiscal deficit is total expenditure less
column2: Total receipts excluding borrowings — the phrase is the whole definition. F4.3 §2.1

column1: Following the restructuring that took effect in September 2025, the principal slabs of the Goods and Services Tax are
column2: 5% and 18%, with a 40% de-merit rate; the 12% and 28% slabs were removed. F4.3 §3.2

column1: The Sixteenth Finance Commission recommended the States' share in the divisible pool of central taxes at
column2: 41%, unchanged from the Fifteenth Commission. (b) 42% is the Fourteenth's figure. F4.3 §4.1

column1: The principle under which an insured person may not recover more than the actual loss suffered is the principle of
column2: Indemnity — the insured is restored to the position before the loss and no better. F7.1

column1: The contribution of the Central Government to the Employees' Pension Scheme is
column2: 1.16%. (b) is a digit reversal; (c) is the employer's pension diversion, offered as the Government's share — the slot-confusion form of T-09

column1: Under the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, prior permission of the appropriate government for retrenchment is required in an industrial establishment employing not less than
column2: 300 under the Code. (b) 100 is the repealed Industrial Disputes Act figure — a number that was correct until 21 November 2025 and is now purely a distractor. See §5.2's four threshold pairs

column1: Article 43A of the Constitution, on the participation of workers in the management of undertakings, was inserted by the
column2: 42nd Amendment, 1976. The 44th is the standard distractor, because it is the other famous emergency-era amendment

column1: Which one of the following bodies is a statutory body?
column2: EPFO's Central Board of Trustees, constituted under the EPF & MP Act. The Finance Commission and the CAG are constitutional; NITI Aayog is neither — it is an executive body

column1: The wage ceiling for provident fund coverage is currently
column2: ₹15,000. ₹25,000 has been approved but not notified, and therefore is not the answer. This is T-09 running forwards in time, and it is exactly F10.2 §2.2's proposed / approved / notified discipline

column1: An increase in the repo rate by the Reserve Bank of India will, other things being equal,
column2: Contract. A higher repo rate makes central-bank funds dearer. (a) is straightforward reversed causation. (d) is unrelated — the SLR is not set by the repo rate

column1: Which one of the following is true of the Cash Reserve Ratio and the Statutory Liquidity Ratio?
column2: The location of the reserve is the whole distinction. CRR sits with the RBI and earns nothing; SLR sits with the bank in specified liquid assets and does earn a return

column1: Fiscal deficit is best defined as
column2: Excluding borrowings is the operative phrase; omit it, as (a) does, and the quantity is trivially zero. (c) defines the revenue deficit and (d) the primary deficit — three definitions in one option set

column1: Life insurance is not a contract of indemnity. It follows that
column2: Subrogation and contribution do not apply. They are corollaries of indemnity. Insurable interest and utmost good faith apply to all insurance contracts, so (a) and (b) are false, and (c) is a non-sequitur

column1: Which one of the following is not a fundamental accounting assumption?
column2: Conservatism is a convention, not a fundamental assumption. The three assumptions are going concern, consistency and accrual. Consistency appears in both lists, which is what makes this item work — a category swap rather than a factual error

column1: Provident fund moneys received by the Government are credited to the
column2: The Public Account of India. The Government holds provident fund moneys as a banker or trustee, so withdrawals need no parliamentary appropriation — unlike the Consolidated Fund. A cross-domain item joining polity, accounting and social security, and exactly the kind this paper favours

column1: In the Laspeyres price index, the weights used are the quantities of the
column2: Base-year quantities. Paasche uses current-year quantities and Fisher's ideal is the geometric mean of the two. L before P as base before current

column1: A sum increases by 20% and then decreases by 20%. The net change is
column2: A 4% decrease. Successive changes are not additive: the net is a + b + ab/100 = 20 − 20 − 4. Any increase followed by an equal percentage decrease always yields a net loss, of exactly the percentage squared over one hundred

column1: A vehicle covers half a given distance at 40 km/h and the other half at 60 km/h. Its average speed is
column2: 48 km/h. Equal distances require the harmonic mean, 2xy/(x+y). (a) 50 is the arithmetic mean, which would be correct only for equal times — and it is the option most candidates take

column1: Labour is a subject in which List of the Seventh Schedule?
column2: Concurrent List — entries 22, 23 and 24. Candidates place labour in the State List because labour administration is largely state-run. That is administration, not legislative competence

column1: The requirement of five years' continuous service for gratuity is not applicable where the termination is due to
column2: Death or disablement. Five years is necessary in the ordinary case, not in every case — the cleanest illustration of necessary-versus-sufficient in the whole syllabus

column1: One who is present everywhere at the same time is
column2: Omnipresent. The omni- family is a fixed set and all four members are examinable. F8.1

column1: The idiom to carry the can means
column2: To carry the can — to take the blame for someone else's fault. F8.1

column1: Find the part containing an error.
column2: The number of takes a singular verb, so have exceeded is wrong. The plural noun applications sitting next to the verb is what pulls you. F8.4

column1: The tribunal's finding was at ______ with the evidence on record.
column2: At odds with — the idiom takes the plural odds. F8.1

column1: According to the passage, compulsion in social insurance is
column2: The passage says compulsion "is the mechanism", not a regrettable feature. F8.3

column1: The passage suggests that Indian social security was tied to the formal enterprise because
column2: Explicit: the enterprise "is where compulsion could be administered". F8.3

column1: The phrase "needed them least intensely" refers to
column2: Those reached by the schemes were the formal-sector workers. The phrase describes them, not the excluded. Requires the sentence's logic, not a keyword match. F8.3

column1: The author's view of recent architecture is best described as
column2: The author is hopeful but conditions success on administration — a hedged position, and hedged options are usually the correct ones. F8.3

column1: An employee's basic wage is ₹15,000 a month. The employer contributes 12%, of which 8.33 percentage points go to the pension scheme and the balance to the provident fund. The monthly amount credited to the provident fund out of the employer's share is
column2: Employer's 12% of ₹15,000 = ₹1,800; the pension share is 8.33% = ₹1,249.50; the balance to provident fund is ₹550.50, being 3.67%. (b) and (d) are the pension figures and (c) the whole contribution. F8.5

column1: A sum becomes ₹8,400 in 2 years and ₹9,660 in 5 years at simple interest. The principal is
The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a sum for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹120. The sum is
column2: Difference for two years = P(r/100)² = P/100 = 120, so P = ₹12,000. F8.5

column1: A worker's output rises by 25% and then falls by 25%. Compared with the original, the final output is
column2: Net = +25 − 25 − 6.25 = 6.25% lower. An equal rise and fall always produces a loss. (a) is the intuition being tested. F8.5

column1: A vehicle covers the first half of a journey at 30 km/h and the second half at 60 km/h. Its average speed for the whole journey is
column2: Equal distances require the harmonic mean: 2(30)(60)/90 = 40 km/h. (b) 45 is the arithmetic mean, correct only for equal times. F8.5

column1: Two pipes fill a tank in 12 and 18 minutes respectively; an outlet empties it in 36 minutes. With all three open, the tank fills in
column2: 1/12 + 1/18 − 1/36 = (3 + 2 − 1)/36 = 4/36, so 9 minutes. The outlet must be subtracted. F8.5

column1: In an office of 200 employees, 60% are members of a provident fund scheme and 45% of a pension scheme, while 25% are members of both. The number who are members of neither is
column2: In at least one = 60 + 45 − 25 = 80%, so neither = 20% of 200 = 40. F8.7

column1: If the radius of a sphere is doubled, its volume becomes
column2: Volume scales as the cube: 2³ = 8 times. (b) is the surface-area factor. F8.6

column1: Statements: All inspectors are officers. Some officers are commissioners. Conclusions: I. Some inspectors are commissioners. II. Some commissioners are officers.
column2: Some officers are commissioners converts to some commissioners are officers, so II follows. I does not — no overlap between inspectors and commissioners is established. F8.8

column1: If in a code TRIBUNAL is written as URJCVOBM, then WAGES is written as
column2: Each letter advances by one: WAGES → XBHFT. F8.8

column1: A man walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, turns right again and walks 5 km. How far is he from his starting point, and in which direction?
column2: North 5, east 3, south 5 returns him to the original latitude, 3 km east. The question asks for displacement, not facing. F8.8

column1: Pointing to a photograph, a woman said, "He is the only son of my mother's only daughter-in-law." How is the man in the photograph related to her?
column2: Her mother's only daughter-in-law is her brother's wife, whose only son is her nephew. F8.8

column1: A body is thrown vertically upward. At the highest point
column2: At the highest point velocity is zero but acceleration remains g downward. Zero velocity does not imply zero acceleration. F9.1

column1: The pressure exerted by a liquid column depends on
column2: Pressure depends on height and density only — not on area, volume or shape. This is the hydrostatic paradox. F9.1

column1: A concave lens always forms an image that is
column2: A concave lens always gives a virtual, erect, diminished image. Always is true here, which is why T-07 must never decide alone. F9.2

column1: The SI unit of magnetic flux is the
column2: Weber is flux; the tesla is flux density. The pair is swapped more often than any other unit pair. F9.2

column1: Hard water does not lather with soap because it contains
column2: Calcium and magnesium ions form an insoluble scum. F9.3

column1: German silver is an alloy of
column2: Copper, zinc and nickel — and German silver contains no silver. F9.3

column1: Deficiency of which vitamin causes defective blood clotting?
column2: Vitamin K is required for the synthesis of clotting factors. F9.4

column1: Kala-azar is transmitted by the
column2: The sandfly. Anopheles carries malaria, Culex filariasis, the tsetse fly sleeping sickness. F9.4

column1: The smallest bone in the human body is the
column2: The stapes, in the middle ear. (a) is the longest bone, offered as the mirror. F9.4

column1: Which memory is the fastest in a computer's memory hierarchy?
column2: The register, inside the CPU. Cache is second-fastest and is the option most often chosen. F9.5

column1: Which protocol is used to send electronic mail?
column2: SMTP sends; POP3 and IMAP receive. F9.7

column1: A switch operates principally at which layer of the OSI model?
column2: A switch works at the data link layer using MAC addresses; a router at the network layer using IP addresses. F9.7

column1: Which SQL command is classified as DDL and removes all rows from a table without logging individual row deletions?
column2: TRUNCATE is DDL and removes all rows without logging each deletion; DELETE is DML and can be rolled back. F9.6

column1: A joint sitting of both Houses of Parliament may be summoned in respect of
column2: A joint sitting under Article 108 lies for an ordinary bill only. It is not available for a Money Bill or a Constitutional Amendment Bill — the exception candidates forget

column1: Which emergency provision of the Constitution has never been invoked?
column2: Article 360, financial emergency, has never been invoked. Article 365 is not an emergency provision

column1: Which writ may be issued against a private individual?
column2: Habeas corpus is the only writ available against a private person

column1: The one-third "split" exception under the Tenth Schedule was deleted by the
column2: The 91st Amendment, 2003, deleted the split exception; the 52nd created the Tenth Schedule. Candidates routinely state the deleted exception as live law

column1: Article 358 provides for the suspension of
column2: Article 358 suspends Article 19 automatically and only in an external emergency. (b) describes Article 359

column1: Which one of the following is not a constitutional body?
column2: The Central Vigilance Commission is statutory. The other three are constitutional

column1: A token cut reduces the amount of the demand for grant by
column2: A token cut reduces the demand by ₹100. (b) ₹1 is the policy cut and (c) is the economy cut — all three in one option set

column1: Trade unions; industrial and labour disputes appears in the
column2: Entry 22 of the Concurrent List. Entry 23 is social security, Entry 24 welfare of labour. Labour is not a State List subject

column1: A Governor, unlike the President, cannot
column2: A Governor may suspend, remit or commute a death sentence but cannot pardon a court-martial sentence or pardon a death sentence. The two differences are the whole question

column1: Which one of the following is correct about the Rajya Sabha?
column2: The Rajya Sabha is a permanent House: it may be prorogued but is never dissolved

column1: The Metropolitan Planning Committee is provided for by Article
column2: 243ZE — Metropolitan Planning Committee. 243ZD is the District Planning Committee, and the two are constantly swapped

column1: The Code which subsumes the largest number of central enactments is the
column2: The OSH and WC Code subsumes 13. Social Security subsumes 9, Industrial Relations 3, Wages 4

column1: Under the Industrial Relations Code, a trade union is recognised as the sole negotiating union where it has the support of not less than
column2: 51% for a sole negotiating union; below that a negotiating council is constituted

column1: The employer's contribution to the Worker Re-skilling Fund on retrenchment is equivalent to
column2: 15 days wages, credited to the Worker Re-skilling Fund

column1: Under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, the contract labour threshold is
column2: 50 under the OSH Code; 20 was the repealed 1970 Act figure

column1: Which one of the following was not subsumed into the Code on Wages, 2019?
column2: The Payment of Gratuity Act went into the Code on Social Security, not the Code on Wages. The other three are the Code on Wages' four, with the Equal Remuneration Act

column1: The floor wage under the Code on Wages is fixed by
column2: The Central Government fixes the floor wage; the appropriate government fixes minimum wages. (c) is the phrase that belongs to the other concept

column1: Notice of a strike under the Industrial Relations Code is required
column2: 14 days, in all industrial establishments — the Code extended to all what the ID Act confined to public utility services. (a) is the repealed position

column1: Which one of the following is not one of the four labour Codes?
column2: There is no "Code on Industrial Safety and Welfare". A plausible, non-existent name — and note it borrows real words from the genuine OSH Code

column1: The Central Government's contribution to the pension scheme is
column2: 1.16%. (a) is the digit reversal, (c) the employer's pension diversion

column1: The maximum assurance benefit under the deposit-linked insurance scheme is
column2: ₹7 lakh. ₹6 lakh was correct only before April 2021

column1: Under Chapter III of the Code on Social Security, EPFO officers including Assistant Provident Fund Commissioners have been appointed as
column2: Recovery Officers, under Chapter III of the Code. The most directly relevant fact in the syllabus to this post. F10.3 §1.3

column1: The minimum monthly pension payable under the pension scheme is
column2: ₹1,000, expressly retained by the 2026 scheme

column1: The claim settlement standard introduced by the Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026 is
column2: Twenty days, with 12% interest where EPFO delays — new under the 2026 scheme

column1: The first Indian woman to preside over a session of the Indian National Congress was
column2: Sarojini Naidu, 1925. Annie Besant was the first woman president, 1917 — a different question with a different answer

column1: The body generally regarded as the first organised trade union in India, founded in 1918, was the
column2: Madras Labour Union, 1918, founded by B. P. Wadia. Lokhande's 1884 body was an association, not a trade union

column1: The first president of the All India Trade Union Congress was
column2: Lala Lajpat Rai. N. M. Joshi is more strongly associated with labour organisation, which is why he is the distractor

column1: Dyarchy in the provinces was introduced by the
column2: 1919 introduced dyarchy in the provinces; 1935 abolished it there and introduced it at the Centre. Learn the migration

column1: The Poona Pact of 1932 replaced separate electorates for the depressed classes with
column2: Reserved seats within the general electorate. The Pact changed the form of reservation; it did not abolish it

column1: Gandhi's first satyagraha in India was launched at
column2: Champaran, 1917. Ahmedabad was the first hunger strike and Kheda the first non-cooperation, both 1918 — three "firsts" inside two years

column1: The Second Round Table Conference was attended on behalf of the Indian National Congress by
column2: Gandhi, alone, following the Gandhi-Irwin Pact. The Congress attended only the second of the three conferences

column1: The newspapers Kesari and Maratha were published by
column2: Tilak — Kesari in Marathi and Maratha in English. Check the language as well as the person

column1: Under the straight line method of depreciation, the annual charge is
column2: Constant under SLM; falling under WDV. F6.4

column1: Amortisation is applied to
column2: Intangibles. Depletion is for wasting natural resources, depreciation for tangible fixed assets. F6.4

column1: In the cash flow statement of a non-financial enterprise, interest paid is classified under
column2: Financing for a non-financial enterprise. For a financial enterprise it moves to operating — the qualification that makes absolute options false. F6.5

column1: The conventional benchmark for the current ratio is
column2: 2 : 1; the quick ratio benchmark is 1 : 1. F6.5

column1: Which one of the following is concerned with the existence, ownership and value of an asset?
column2: Verification covers existence, ownership and value; vouching examines evidence for a transaction, and valuation sits inside verification. F6.7

column1: The Laspeyres price index uses as weights the quantities of
column2: Base year. Paasche uses current-year quantities. L before P as base before current. F6.8

column1: To compare the variability of two series measured in different units, the appropriate measure is the
column2: The coefficient of variation is unit-free; standard deviation carries the data's units and cannot compare across units. F6.8

column1: Rejecting a null hypothesis which is in fact true is
column2: Type I — rejecting a true null. Type II accepts a false one. F6.8

column1: Which reserve requirement is held with the Reserve Bank of India and earns no interest?
column2: CRR is held with the RBI and earns nothing; SLR is held by the bank itself and does earn. The location is the discriminator. F4.2

column1: The floor of the liquidity adjustment facility corridor is the
column2: The Standing Deposit Facility, which replaced the fixed-rate reverse repo as the floor in 2022 and is uncollateralised. (a) is the superseded answer. F4.2

column1: Fiscal deficit is total expenditure minus total receipts
column2: Excluding borrowings. Omit those two words and the quantity is trivially zero. F4.3

column1: Which one of the following price indices excludes services altogether?
column2: WPI excludes services entirely — its single most examined feature. F4.2

column1: The index used for computing dearness allowance is compiled by
column2: The Labour Bureau compiles CPI-IW, the basis of dearness allowance. The NSO compiles CPI-Combined. Directly relevant to this post. F4.2

column1: Remittances received from abroad are recorded in the
column2: The current account, as secondary income. Placing remittances in the capital account is the standard error. F4.2

column1: The Sixteenth Finance Commission is chaired by
column2: Arvind Panagariya, succeeding N. K. Singh of the Fifteenth. The award period begins 2026, which is why it is topical. F10.3

column1: Foreign direct investment in the insurance sector was raised to 100% with effect from
column2: 5 February 2026, automatic route, with LIC still capped at 20%. F7.1, F10.3

column1: The rural employment guarantee under the Act of 2025 provides for
column2: 125 days under the Act of 2025, in force 1 July 2026. 100 days is the superseded MGNREGA figure and the intended distractor. F4.4, F10.3

column1: The India-United Kingdom Double Contributions Convention coordinates
column2: It coordinates contributions and not benefits, with a 60-month detachment exemption — and EPFO itself administers it. F10.3 §1.5

column1: India has not ratified which pair of ILO Conventions?
column2: 87 and 98 — freedom of association and collective bargaining. India has ratified the other six fundamental conventions

column1: Life insurance is a contract of
column2: Assurance. Life insurance is not a contract of indemnity, because a life cannot be valued — and it follows that subrogation and contribution do not apply either. F7.1

column1: An abnormal fear of confined spaces is
column2: Claustrophobia. Agoraphobia is fear of open or public spaces — the intended near-miss. F8.1

column1: The idiom to throw in the towel means
column2: To throw in the towel — to admit defeat, from boxing. F8.1

column1: His statement was wholly ______ with the documents on record.
column2: Inconsistent with — the only one of the four that takes with and carries the required sense. F8.1

column1: The author's central contention is that
column2: The passage's thesis. The author explicitly denies that consolidation is undesirable, so the strongest-sounding option is not the right one. F8.3

column1: According to the passage, the correct sceptical question about a social security reform is whether
column2: Stated almost verbatim: the question is "whether the obligation is collectible". F8.3

column1: The author regards simplification as
column2: The author calls simplification a genuine gain, but in compliance cost rather than coverage — a hedged, two-part position, and hedged options are usually correct. F8.3

column1: The phrase "Generosity on paper is free" is used to suggest that
column2: The contrast is between the cost of announcing and the cost of enforcing. F8.3

column1: An employer defaults on dues of ₹60,000. Simple interest at 12% per annum for four months is
column2: 60,000 × 12/100 × 4/12 = ₹2,400. The four-month fraction is where the errors occur. F8.5

column1: A sum at compound interest amounts to ₹4,840 in two years and ₹5,324 in three years. The rate per annum is
column2: 5,324 ÷ 4,840 = 1.10, so the rate is 10%. Successive CI amounts differ by a factor of (1 + r). F8.5

column1: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5. If each is increased by 10, the ratio becomes 5 : 7. The sum of the original numbers is
column2: (3x + 10)/(5x + 10) = 5/7 gives x = 5, so the numbers are 15 and 25 and the sum is 40. F8.5

column1: A completes one-third of a work in 5 days and B completes two-fifths of the same work in 8 days. Working together they will finish the whole work in
column2: A's full work is 15 days, B's 20. Together 1/15 + 1/20 = 7/60, so 8 and four-sevenths days. Convert the part-work to whole-work first. F8.5

column1: A man rows 12 km downstream in 2 hours and returns in 3 hours. The speed of the stream is
column2: Downstream 6 km/h, upstream 4 km/h, so stream = (6 − 4)/2 = 1 km/h. Half the difference, not the difference. F8.5

column1: An article is marked 25% above cost and then sold at a discount of 20%. The profit percentage is
column2: CP 100, MP 125, SP = 125 × 0.8 = 100, so profit is nil. A 25% mark-up and a 20% discount cancel exactly. F8.5

column1: The average age of 5 members of a committee is 30 years. A sixth member joins and the average becomes 29 years. The age of the new member is
column2: Total was 150; the new total is 29 × 6 = 174, so the new member is 24. F8.5

column1: The unemployment rate rises from 5% to 6%. This is correctly described as
column2: A rise from 5% to 6% is one percentage point and 20%. Both descriptions are correct, and the item requires you to notice that the complete answer contains both. F8.5

column1: Statements: All commissioners are officers. No officer is a clerk. Conclusions: I. No commissioner is a clerk. II. Some officers are commissioners.
column2: From All commissioners are officers and No officer is a clerk, no commissioner is a clerk; and the first premise converts to some officers are commissioners. Both follow. F8.8

column1: If 1 January 2026 is a Thursday, then 1 March 2026 is a
column2: 2026 is not a leap year, so 1 January to 1 March is 31 + 28 = 59 days; 59 mod 7 = 3; Thursday + 3 = Sunday. The leap-year check is the trap. F8.8

column1: The angle between the hands of a clock at 3:40 is
column2: Angle = 30H − 5.5M = 90 − 220, and its magnitude is 130 degrees. F8.8

column1: A body moving in a circle at constant speed has
column2: Constant speed is not constant velocity: the direction changes, so there is a centripetal acceleration. F9.1

column1: The work done by the centripetal force in uniform circular motion is
column2: Zero — the centripetal force is perpendicular to the displacement at every instant. F9.1

column1: The SI unit of radioactivity is the
column2: Becquerel measures radioactivity; the gray measures absorbed dose and the sievert dose equivalent. Three units of the same family. F9.2

column1: Baking soda is chemically
column2: Sodium bicarbonate. Sodium carbonate is washing soda. F9.3

column1: The fat-soluble vitamins are
column2: A, D, E and K are fat-soluble; the B complex and C are water-soluble. F9.4

column1: The largest gland in the human body is the
column2: The liver, which is both the largest gland and the largest internal organ. F9.4

column1: The blood group regarded as the universal donor is
column2: O negative is the universal donor; AB positive is the universal recipient. F9.4

column1: Integrated circuits characterised which generation of computers?
column2: Third generation. First used vacuum tubes, second transistors, fourth microprocessors. F9.5

column1: An IPv6 address is of length
column2: 128 bits, against IPv4's 32. The 64-bit option corresponds to nothing. F9.7

column1: In the OSI model, the layer immediately above the network layer is the
column2: The order upward is physical, data link, network, transport, session, presentation, application. F9.7

column1: A worm differs from a virus in that a worm
column2: A worm self-replicates and spreads without user action; a virus needs a host file, a trojan disguises itself. F9.6

column1: Laws placed in the Ninth Schedule
column2: Since the 2007 decision, Ninth Schedule laws remain open to challenge on basic structure grounds. "Absolute immunity" is the absolute that fails

column1: The words socialist and secular were inserted into the Preamble by the
column2: The 42nd Amendment, 1976, which added socialist, secular and integrity

column1: Which right was removed from Part III and re-enacted as Article 300A?
column2: The right to property, deleted by the 44th Amendment and re-enacted as Article 300A, a legal right

column1: The quorum for a sitting of either House of Parliament is
column2: One-tenth of the total membership

column1: A State Finance Commission is required to be constituted every
column2: Every five years, as with the Union Finance Commission

column1: Which writ is curative rather than preventive?
column2: Certiorari quashes an order already made and is curative; prohibition stops proceedings and is preventive

column1: Under the 73rd Amendment, the three-tier structure is mandatory only in States with a population exceeding
column2: Twenty lakh. Below that a State need not constitute the intermediate tier

column1: Article 359 permits the suspension of the enforcement of rights, but the enforcement of which Articles can never be suspended?
column2: Articles 20 and 21, protected by the 44th Amendment

column1: The award period of the Sixteenth Finance Commission begins in
column2: 2026, which is why the Sixteenth Finance Commission is topical this cycle

column1: Which enactment was not subsumed into the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code?
column2: The Trade Unions Act, 1926 went into the Industrial Relations Code. The other three are all OSH Code

column1: Under the Industrial Relations Code, standing orders apply to an industrial establishment employing
column2: 300 or more. 100 was the repealed 1946 Act figure and is now purely a distractor

column1: The Industrial Relations Code prohibits a strike during conciliation proceedings and for
column2: Seven days after the conclusion of conciliation proceedings, and sixty days after tribunal proceedings

column1: A fixed term employee under the Industrial Relations Code is entitled to gratuity
column2: Pro rata, without the five-year qualifying period. One of the Code's genuinely new entitlements

column1: The aggregator's contribution towards gig and platform workers is expressed as
column2: One to two per cent of turnover, capped by reference to the amounts paid to gig and platform workers

column1: The so-called fifty per cent rule in the definition of wages is designed to
column2: To prevent structuring remuneration to shrink the wage component, and therefore the provident fund contribution. F10.3 §1.2 identifies this as the change with the largest practical effect on EPFO administration

column1: Under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, an appointment letter is
column2: Mandatory for every employee — a small provision with large consequences for informal employment

column1: The Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 was replaced by
column2: The Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026. Each 1952, 1995 and 1976 scheme was replaced by its own 2026 successor — do not let the pension scheme absorb all three

column1: Pensionable salary is the average of the last
column2: 60 months, raised from 12 in 2014 and carried into the 2026 scheme

column1: The age of superannuation under the pension scheme is
column2: 58, not 60. The commonest single error in this subject

column1: Orphan pension is payable at what proportion of the widow pension?
column2: 75 per cent of widow pension for an orphan; children's pension is 25 per cent for up to two children. The larger figure attaching to the orphan is counter-intuitive, which is why it is asked

column1: The bonus component of the deposit-linked insurance benefit is subject to a ceiling of
column2: ₹1,75,000, which with the 35× component produces the ₹7 lakh maximum

column1: Under EPFO 3.0, the proportion of the accumulated balance that may be withdrawn through UPI is up to
column2: Up to 75 per cent by UPI, under EPFO 3.0. F10.3 §1.3

column1: The Ahmedabad mill workers' dispute of 1918 is significant as Gandhi's first use in India of
column2: The hunger strike. Champaran 1917 was the first satyagraha and Kheda 1918 the first non-cooperation — three "firsts" inside two years

column1: The Communal Award of 1932 was announced by
column2: Ramsay MacDonald, August 1932, superseded a month later by the Poona Pact

column1: The Karachi session of 1931 is remembered for its resolution on
column2: Fundamental Rights and Economic Policy, Karachi 1931. Purna Swaraj was Lahore 1929

column1: Separate electorates were first introduced in India by the
column2: 1909, Morley-Minto, for Muslims; 1919 extended the principle to other communities and 1935 further still

column1: The Whitley Commission, which reported between 1929 and 1931, was concerned with
column2: Labour — the Royal Commission on Labour, 1929 to 1931

column1: Deferred revenue expenditure is
column2: Revenue in nature but written off over several periods — which is what makes it deferred. F6.2

column1: The inventory turnover ratio is classified as
column2: An activity or turnover ratio, not a liquidity ratio — the standard classification trap. F6.5

column1: The purchase of a fixed asset appears in the cash flow statement under
column2: Investing activities. F6.5

column1: Propriety audit is concerned with
column2: Wisdom, faithfulness and economy — the classic formulation, going beyond mere legality. F6.7

column1: Which body, constituted in 2018, oversees auditing standards and discipline for specified classes of companies?
column2: The National Financial Reporting Authority, 2018. The ICAI dates from 1949 and is a professional body. F6.7

column1: Fisher's ideal index is the
column2: The geometric mean, which is why Fisher's index satisfies the time-reversal and factor-reversal tests. F6.8

column1: In a moderately skewed distribution, the mode is approximately
column2: Mode is approximately 3 Median − 2 Mean. The coefficients and their order are both examinable, and reversing them is the trap. F6.8

column1: The N. K. Singh Committee recommended a debt-to-GDP anchor of
column2: 60 per cent in total, 40 Centre and 20 States. Learn the triple as a set. F4.3

column1: The Goods and Services Tax Council takes decisions by a majority of
column2: Three-fourths of weighted votes, with the Centre holding one-third and the States two-thirds of the weight. F4.3

column1: The classification of micro, small and medium enterprises since 2020 is based on
column2: Both investment and turnover, since the 2020 composite criterion. F4.4

column1: The priority sector lending target for a domestic scheduled commercial bank is
column2: 40 per cent of adjusted net bank credit; 18 per cent is the agriculture sub-target. F4.2

column1: Disguised unemployment in India is characteristically associated with
column2: Agriculture. Cyclical unemployment is characteristically a developed-economy phenomenon; disguised unemployment is characteristically Indian agriculture. F4.4

column1: Under the Periodic Labour Force Survey, the usual status is determined with reference to a period of
column2: 365 days for usual status; the seven-day period is current weekly status. The pair is routinely swapped. F4.4

column1: EPFO has reduced its thirteen categories of withdrawal to
column2: Three, from thirteen. F10.3 §1.3

column1: The detachment exemption under that Convention runs for
column2: 60 months of detachment exemption. F10.3 §1.5

column1: Foreign direct investment of 100 per cent in insurance is permitted through
column2: The automatic route. F7.1, F10.3

column1: Foreign shareholding in the Life Insurance Corporation remains capped at
column2: 20 per cent for LIC, notwithstanding the general 100 per cent. The exception is the question. F7.1

column1: The rural employment guarantee Act of 2025 is referred to in short as
column2: VB-G RAM G, in force 1 July 2026, replacing MGNREGA and raising the guarantee to 125 days. F10.3

column1: Insurable interest is required to exist at the time of the loss, and not merely when the policy is taken, in the case of
column2: Marine insurance — insurable interest must exist at the time of loss. In life it must exist when the policy is taken; in fire, at both times. The three-way split is the item. F7.1
